title: Hadrian careers box
description: A hiring call to action in a 1px white box: a band across the top where a wide gold uppercase slogan loops leftward with faded edges, then a tight heading, a short paragraph and a solid gold mono button; an image fades in from the left across the right half (behind the copy on phones).
notes: the marquee is a CSS loop; it stops under reduced motion
the image's left fade is the page colour, so it melts into any theme's background
name: hadrian-careers

props.name: slogan
props.description: the slogan that loops across the top band (shown uppercase)

props.name: media
props.description: image on the right half (behind the copy on phones), object-cover; a placeholder when empty

props.name: loopSeconds
props.description: seconds for the slogan to travel one run
